description_en: Dathu Bāhāḥ is a member of the branch of Mayūravarṇa Mahāvihāra and is situated southwest of this monument. It is one of threebāhāḥsthat are located near to the Mayūravarṇa Mahāvihāra at its southeast corner. Dathu is positioned in between these, which is how it gained its name. The Bāhāḥ can be accessed through an underpass underneath a residential building from the western Cidhaṃ Bāhāḥ (LAL2070). This Bāhāḥ has been built on the eastern wing and faces west. At present, however, it consists only of a ground floor, and this is also in ruins.Before 2015, this site was a three-storey Bāhāḥ complex. Three plain windows were installed on its first floor, and a secret room was located on this level. The second floor contained atrikhājhyāḥflanked by two plain windows. The roof of the Bāhāḥwas made from zinc sheets. However, the first and second floors collapsed during the 2015 earthquake. Although the ground floor was badly damaged, the sanctum of the Bāhāḥ has remained safe.The ground floor has three colonnaded bays on its main facade; the central bay holds the main door. The space between the columns on the right-hand side is filled with brick masonry, while a small entry way can be found on the left. The architecture shows that this Bāhāḥ has stood witness to different periods of time. The main door is well carved and once was surmounted by a ṭoraṇathãheld up by stone lions, however theṭoraṇawas removed after the earthquake. Historical photos show that the first and second floor contained a single opening window and a triple-bay window (svapājhyaḥ) respectively. The back wall (to the east) has been heavily damaged and parts of it have collapsed. The main sanctum room has been covered with CGI sheets to protect it from rain. The courtyard (8.95m x 7.25m) is paved inteliatiles, and contains a Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala and a Śikharakūṭa Caitya (160cm high) lined up in the central axis in front of the main sanctum (to the west). The courtyard is still filled with debris from the collapsed building materials.Inside the sanctum, the stone statue of the seated main deity, Akṣobhya Buddha, faces west. The original statue was stolen some time between 1983-1985. Later, a similar statue was enshrined and covered with a metal garment. After the 2015 earthquakes, however, the metal garment of the deity disappeared. A small stone Caitya and a stone with sculpted images of four donors has also been preserved inside the sanctum. Before the earthquake, there was also a woodentoraṇadated NS 1004 with an image of Akṣobhya in the middle, Prajñāpāramitā on the right and Ṣaḍakṣarī Lokeśvara on the left (Locke1985,87). After the earthquake, broken pieces of thetoraṇawere found scattered around, but the piece containing the date could not be located. The pinnacle which was once fixed on top of thetoraṇacan now be seen above the entrance. Images of Hanumān and Mahākāla also survived the earthquake; they are now placed to the north and the south of the entrance.
description_ne: यो दथु विहार मयूरवर्ण महाविहार वा भिन्छे बाहा:को शाखाविहार हो । यो विहार भिन्छे बाहा:को दक्षिण-पूर्व दिशामा अवस्थित छ । भिन्छे बाहा:को दक्षिण-पूर्व दिशामा रहेका तीनवटा साना विहारहरूमध्ये बीचमा पर्ने हुनाले यसलाई दथु बाहा: (बीचमा रहेको बाहा:) भनिएको हो ।सन् २०१५ को भूकम्पले यो विहारलाई बेसरी क्षति पुर्यायो । भूकम्पअघि यो विहार तीन तलाको थियो । विहारको पहिलो तलाको बीचमा एउटा र दायाँ-बायाँ पनि एक-एकवटा सामान्य झ्याल थिए । त्यस तलामा विहारको आगम रहेको थियो । दोस्रो तलाको बीचमा एउटा त्रिखाझ्या: थियो भने त्यसको दायाँ-बायाँ पनि एक-एकवटा सादा झ्याल राखिएका थिए, अनि छाना जस्तापाताले छाइएको थियो ।भूकम्पले पहिलो र दोस्रो तला पूरै भत्कियो तर पनि दोस्रो तलामा बसोवास गरिरहेका मानिसहरू बाहिर गएको समयमा भूकम्प गएकोले मानवीय क्षति भने हुन पाएन । विहारको भुइँतलामा केही क्षति पुगे पनि गर्भगृह सुरक्षित रह्यो ।अहिले भुइँतलाको माथि जस्तापाताले छोपिएको छ । विहारको गर्भगृहमा क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा पश्चिमाभिमुख अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध रहेका छन् । सन् १९८३-८५ तिर अक्षोभ्यको पुरानो मूर्ति चोरी भएपछि त्यससँग हुबहु मिल्ने गरी  ढुंगाको नयाँ  मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको थियो । अक्षोभ्यको मूर्तिलाई धातुको इलां पनि ओडाइएको थियो । तर सन् २०१५ को भूकम्पपछि सो इलां पनि चोरी भयो । गर्भगृहभित्र सानो ढुंगाको चैत्य र चारजना दाताको प्रतिमा रहेको ढुंगा देख्न सकिन्छ । विहारको मूल प्रवेशद्वारमाथि नेसं १००४ मिति अङ्कित अभिलेख भएको काठको तोरण राखिएको थियो जसको बीचमा अक्षोभ्य, दायाँ प्रज्ञापारमिता र बायाँ षडक्षरी लोकेश्वरको प्रतिमा थियो (लक १९८५, ८७) । तर त्यो तोरण भूकम्पले भवन भत्किँदा पुरियो, पछि भग्नावशेष हटाउँदा तोरणका केही टुक्रा भेटिए तर पनि  अभिलेख कुँदिएको भाग भने भेटिएन । तोरणको माथि रहेको गजूर चाहिँ अहिले पनि प्रवेशद्वारको माथि राखिएको छ । प्रवेशद्वारको उत्तरपट्टि राखिएको हनुमान्‌को मूर्ति र दक्षिणतिर राखिएको महाकाल र गणेशको मूर्ति भने सुरक्षित छ ।विहार परिसरमा एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल र एउटा शिखरकूट चैत्य रहेको छ । भत्किएको विहारको भग्नावशेष अहिलेसम्म पनि राम्ररी सफा गरिएको छैन ।

historical_events.event_description: This inscription is engraved on the southwest, south and southeast sides of the Dharmadhātu Maṇḍalā. The main actor's name is not legible, but other family names can be read: the donor's grandfather Siddhiju, elder uncle Nhuccheju, father Cidhiju, mother Amit Lakṣmī, elder sister Thakũmati, younger sister Bhīma Thakũ, daughter Rāni Thakũ, younger brother Dhija(bī)ra, youngest brother Bhājupati.
The monastic building collapsed during the earthquake.

Thetoraṇaover the main entrance to Kvāpādyaḥ was donated. However, it was buried under rubble after the building was destroyed in the 2015 earthquake. Thetoraṇabroke into pieces when it was extracted from the rubble.
